First, I should understand what the action is. The person is saying they deserve a fun time because they worked hard for better concert seats. So, the action here is probably going to the concert and enjoying it because they put in extra effort.

Now, I need to evaluate the morality of this action. Morality often involves whether an action is right or wrong based on societal norms, ethics, or personal beliefs. So, putting it all together, the action of enjoying a fun time after working hard for better concert seats doesn't seem to have any moral issues. It's a positive reinforcement of their efforts without causing harm to others.
